payload.claim: `_PageParser`'s docstring enumerates its public attributes (`tables`, `header_rows`, `row_kinds`, `table_ids`, `headings3`, `summary`, hrefs, heading, title, text) but was not updated to mention the two attributes this diff adds, `dls` (line 184) and `texts_by_id` (line 188), both of which the new witnesses (e.g. `page.dls["spec"][...]`, `page.texts_by_id["problem"]`) rely on. The docstring is no longer a complete account of what the parser records.
